sources.title: Fox-IT investigation report (via Maastricht University)
sources.what_it_gave: phishing Excel -> SDBBot, EternalBlue lateral spread, domain-admin compromise, Clop on 267 servers

sources.title: Maastricht University Ransomware Attack Flow (CTID corpus)
sources.what_it_gave: phish -> SDBBot/Meterpreter -> EternalBlue -> AD discovery -> LSASS DA creds -> Clop on DC/Exchange/backup/file servers

narrative_before: In October 2019 a phishing Excel macro downloaded the SDBBot malware onto a Maastricht University server, which communicated with its C2 over TCP and deployed an in-memory Meterpreter shell (Fox-IT report). The attacker spread Meterpreter to internal servers by exploiting the EternalBlue vulnerability (CVE-2017-0144) and escalated to the local SYSTEM account, then ran Active Directory discovery (PowerSploit, PingCastle, AdFind) and dumped LSASS to recover domain-administrator credentials. With domain-admin rights they surveyed all servers, disabled McAfee and Microsoft Defender, and placed ransomware deployment tools; on 23 December 2019 Clop ransomware was launched across the UNIMAAS domain, encrypting at least 267 internal servers including the domain controller, Exchange servers, file servers and some backup servers.

detection_moments.description: Initial access: phishing Excel macro downloads SDBBot (with in-memory Meterpreter) onto a university server.
detection_moments.evidence: 'Malicious Microsoft Excel file is attached in a phishing campaign ... An interactive shell is deployed by another malware included in SDBBot' - CTID flow / Fox-IT

detection_moments.description: EternalBlue lateral spread to internal servers, privilege escalation, and LSASS dumping of domain-admin credentials.
detection_moments.evidence: 'spreads Meterpreter malware to different internal servers through an unpatched vulnerability [EternalBlue] ... retrieves the login credential stored in memory ... administrator account of the domain' - CTID flow / Fox-IT

detection_moments.description: Clop ransomware launched domain-wide on 23 Dec 2019, encrypting the DC, Exchange, file and backup servers (267+ servers).
detection_moments.evidence: 'launches ransomware attack on all infected servers in the UNIMAAS domain' - CTID flow / Fox-IT; '267 internal servers were affected'

attack_path: EternalBlue (CVE-2017-0144) exploitation of remote services - T1210
AD discovery + LSASS domain-admin credential theft leading to DC control - T1003.001
domain-wide Clop deployment with domain-admin rights - T1486
ambiguities: 267+ encrypted servers are not individually named; modelled by role (DC, Exchange, file, backup) plus one generic lateral server.
Fox-IT report is in Dutch; narrative figures follow the English summary and the CTID flow's paraphrase.
Detection: antivirus (McAfee) flagged the staged malware but was disabled; m3 is the 23 Dec 2019 encryption event (first undeniable detection).
